blind.description: A low stylized wooden fence panel featuring wattle or wicker weave styling. It consists of four vertical wooden posts connected by horizontal top and bottom wooden rails, interwoven with thick braided/woven wooden branches or wicker strips. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and stylized/hand-painted textured wood with warm brown tones. The model stands directly on its post bases without an artificial base or ground slab.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal bar with four slightly protruding vertical post caps along its length, two central posts being slightly rounded/curved around the weave.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.2 feet tall (around knee-to-mid-thigh height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 4.5 feet wide.
